name: Nigeria
description: Nigeria is 247Market's largest community, with buyers and sellers trading daily across Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt and Ibadan. From Lekki apartments to Alaba electronics, it's the fastest-moving marketplace on the platform.

name: Ghana
tagline: Accra's home for fair, direct deals
description: In Ghana, 247Market connects traders across Accra, Kumasi and Takoradi. Whether it's a plot of land in East Legon or a shop's worth of textiles, sellers list directly and buyers deal with real, verified people.

name: Kenya
description: Kenya's 247Market community trades from Nairobi's Westlands to Mombasa's coastline — matatus, smartphones, farm equipment and rentals all find buyers here, with M-Pesa-friendly sellers across the board.

name: South Africa
tagline: Trusted trading from Cape Town to Joburg
description: South Africa brings a wide mix of listings — bakkies in Pretoria, furniture in Cape Town, and tech gear out of Johannesburg. 247Market's verification badges help buyers shop with confidence in every province.

name: Egypt
tagline: Cairo's marketplace for the modern trader
description: 247Market Egypt serves buyers and sellers from Cairo, Alexandria and Giza — apartments near the Nile, imported electronics and family cars are among the most searched listings on the platform.

name: Morocco
tagline: From Casablanca souks to online listings
description: Morocco's traders bring the energy of the souk online — Casablanca's tech resellers, Marrakech's craft sellers and Rabat's property listings all trade through 247Market's verified profiles.

name: Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia's marketplace is centered around Addis Ababa, where sellers list everything from imported vehicles to home appliances, giving buyers across the region a single place to compare offers.

name: Tanzania
tagline: Dar es Salaam's trusted trading post
description: Tanzania's 247Market users trade out of Dar es Salaam, Arusha and Zanzibar — from safari-ready vehicles to beachfront rentals, with every listing tied to a verified local seller.

name: Uganda
description: Ugandan sellers list motorcycles, land and electronics from Kampala, Entebbe and Jinja, giving buyers across East Africa a direct line to trusted, verified traders around the clock.

name: Senegal
tagline: Dakar's marketplace for francophone West Africa
description: Senegal's community trades from Dakar and Thiès, listing everything from fishing boats to city apartments — 247Market gives francophone West Africa a familiar, trusted place to buy and sell.

name: Côte d'Ivoire
description: Abidjan anchors Côte d'Ivoire's 247Market activity, with cocoa-belt entrepreneurs and city sellers listing vehicles, electronics and commercial space to a steadily growing buyer base.

name: Rwanda
description: Rwanda's listings reflect Kigali's fast-modernizing economy — tech gear, serviced apartments and small business equipment, all posted by verified sellers in one of Africa's cleanest marketplaces.

name: Cameroon
description: Cameroon's traders operate mainly out of Douala and Yaoundé, listing vehicles, land and imported goods for a bilingual buyer base spanning both the coast and the capital.

name: Zambia
description: Zambia's 247Market community is centered in Lusaka, where sellers list farm equipment, vehicles and household goods for buyers across the Copperbelt and beyond.
